claims.claim_text: Two institutional publications support a high-confidence match for indexed Udom Puhpadhana, a Thai student who later served with the Free Thai movement.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The distinctive exact name, Thai background, U.S. education, and later Free Thai service form a coherent chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence distinctive exact-name, nationality, education, and wartime-service match across two institutional sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources document student status in 1942 and later wartime service; they do not establish the exact OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: Student attendance and military service are kept separate from employment.

claims.claim_text: Udom Puhpadhana was a student at Miami University in 1942.

claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive exact name and independent wartime chronology support a high-confidence match.

claims.match_notes: Miami University is not classified as an employer.
